fixture_name: Cloverleaf-to-urban interchange conversion — INT preliminary design (Wikimedia PD geometry)
subject: judge-baseline

justifications.substance: Uncontrolled shared-use-path crossings at free-flowing retained-loop ramp terminals are a genuine VRU safety hazard directly relevant to the corridor's recorded continuity objectives at preliminary-design stage.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Pivotal claim is anchored by the verbatim EV-IN-016 checklist quote and corroborated by the verbatim EV-IN-005 thematic-audit/VRU quote, while the scenario rests on recorded objectives and layout facts; only the 'northern' terminal label is a mild extrapolation.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly filed as a safety_concern (vru_continuity); PIARC checklist prompts serve as supporting normative basis without being converted into a compliance claim, keeping safety and compliance categorically distinct.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Specific and stage-viable: names concrete tools (Walkability Checklist, CQSI) and treatments (signalised or grade-separated crossings at both retained loop-ramp terminals), though the 'northern' terminal reference lacks evidential anchoring.
justifications.vru_coverage: Pedestrians and cyclists are the explicit focus of the finding, with their exposure at ramp-terminal crossings analysed directly, giving full VRU consideration.
